title: lazycmd project profile
description:
~/.config/lazycmd/projects/<name>.yaml: a central profile for one repo, kept outside the repo. Matched by path (the repo or any folder below a listed path) or, with no path, by the file name equalling the repo's folder name. Keep in sync with internal/config/project.go. Reference from a YAML file with:
  # yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../path/to/lazycmd-profile.schema.json

path.description: Repo this profile is for. ~ is expanded; a relative path is relative to this file.

include.description: Commands to add to 'This project'. Each entry is a script (its <name>.lazycmd.yaml sidecar beside it is picked up), a <name>.lazycmd.yaml sidecar (its script sits beside it, or the sidecar sets run:/script:), a commands.yaml-shaped file, or a folder of scripts. ~ is expanded; relative paths are relative to this file. The repo's own .lazycmd/ wins on a name clash.

defaults.description: Preselected values for param forms, keyed by command name ('deploy-staging', 'maven: test') or id ('global:deploy-staging'), then by param name. Applies to any command, including discovered feature commands. Values stay editable in the form. A value can refer to another param of the same command as ${name}; references resolve when the form opens, from that param's default, and chain. A list preselects options of a multi param.

features.description: Switch features back on that a broader file disabled.

disable.description: Features to turn off for this repo.
